### Mdns { #mdns-kt-mdns }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">object</span> <span class="nc">Mdns</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/io/osc/query/Mdns/#L28)

Just enough multicast DNS (RFC 6762) and DNS-SD (RFC 6763) to advertise and find OSCQuery services, with no dependency: a responder that answers PTR/SRV/TXT/A questions for the services registered with `advertise`, and a one-shot `browse`.

### OscQueryServices { #oscquerybox-kt-oscqueryservices }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">object</span> <span class="nc">OscQueryServices</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/io/osc/query/OscQueryBox/#L23)

Process-wide OSCQuery state behind `Box.oscQuery`: one [`OscQueryServer`](networking.md#oscqueryserver-kt-oscqueryserver) per HTTP port, the remotes a box has opened, and the queue that brings callbacks onto the main Runloop.

## OscQueryCodec.kt { #oscquerycodec-kt }

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/io/osc/query/OscQueryCodec.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/io/osc/query/OscQueryCodec/)

### OscQueryCodec { #oscquerycodec-kt-oscquerycodec }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">object</span> <span class="nc">OscQueryCodec</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/io/osc/query/OscQueryCodec/#L15)

The OSC 1.0 message encoding OSCQuery puts in WebSocket binary frames: an address, a type-tag string and big-endian arguments, each padded to four bytes. Handles `i f s d h T F N`, which is every type an OSCQuery parameter here can have; a bundle or an unknown tag decodes to `null`.

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">OscQueryServer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">&quot;Field&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">httpPort</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Int</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">oscPort</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Int</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">bindAddress</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">&quot;0.0.0.0&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">advertise</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">dispatch</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nc">Runnable</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">Unit</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="kc">it</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">run</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">}</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Closeable</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/io/osc/query/OscQueryServer/#L140)

An OSCQuery service: the namespace of `params`, served as JSON over HTTP at `http://<host>:<httpPort>/` (with a WebSocket on the same port for `LISTEN`), set over OSC UDP at `oscPort`, and advertised over DNS-SD as `_oscjson._tcp` and `_osc._udp` when `advertise` is on.
